$comment: SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for all narration. scripts/generate-elevenlabs-audio.mjs generates every file from this; src/playlab/shared/audio/voice.ts plays them; UI components take displayed text from here so screen text and speech can never mismatch.

elevenLabs.$note: Used by scripts/generate-elevenlabs-audio.mjs — the CURRENT generator. voiceName is resolved to an id at run time (a Voice Library voice must first be added to the account); voiceId, when set, wins. TONE IS PER FAMILY on purpose: 'teaching' clips (phonics/letter/number) stay stable so the same sound is taught identically every time, 'cheer' is the most expressive, everything else is 'warm'. ElevenLabs does NOT honour inline <phoneme> SSML, so the 26 phonics clips fall back to their 'speakFree' respelling; add an 'elevenSpeak' field to any clip to tune what is said without touching the on-screen 'text'.
